findings.friction_name: checkout dead-ends with a blank page after payment submit
findings.narrative: Every numeric factor is traceable to its own fixed mapping and matches the recorded evidence category: raw_within_run_reencounter_count=1 maps frequency=0 (F159); terminal_recovery_outcome='task-abandoned-or-never-resumed' maps impact=4 (F161); same_run_recurrence_count is defined as F136's raw within-run re-encounter count minus 1, so 1-1=0, mapping persistence=0 (F162's '0=0' bucket, corrected CR5-B4 — the pre-CR5 bucket table double-counted this same observation as an independently-authored count). severity=round(mean(0,4,0))=round(1.33)=1, correctly passing the F12 arithmetic gate with every input mapped from ONE within-run re-encounter observation, not two independently-verified NN/g inputs (F181), and not free judgment (CR4-B3/CR5-B4, negative control).
